troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.copied_to_clipboard: Info copied to the clipboard! Feel free to share it on our Discord if you need help.
troubleshooting.chromium_tip: terron runs best on Chromium-based browsers.
troubleshooting.hardware_acceleration_tip: Make sure hardware acceleration is enabled in your browser settings for optimal performance.
troubleshooting.gpu_tip: Verify that this is the dedicated GPU, if one is available.
troubleshooting.power_saving_tip: Make sure that your browser is not set to power saving mode.

help_modal.action_esc: Closes menu. Cancels unit build preview.
help_modal.action_attack_altclick: Attack (when left click is set to open menu)
help_modal.action_warship_multiselect: Select multiple warships (drag to draw selection box)
help_modal.ui_leaderboard_desc: Shows the top players of the game and their names, % owned land, gold and troops. Using Show All shows all players in the game. If you don't want to see the leaderboard, click Hide.
help_modal.ui_control_desc: The control panel contains the following elements:
help_modal.ui_gold: Gold - The amount of gold you have and the rate at which you gain it.
help_modal.ui_attack_ratio: Attack ratio - The amount of troops that will be used when you attack. You can adjust the attack ratio using the slider. Having more attacking troops than defending troops will make you lose fewer troops in the attack, while having less will increase the damage dealt to your attacking troops. The effect doesn't go beyond ratios of 2:1.
help_modal.ui_events_desc: The Event panel displays the latest events, requests and Quick Chat messages. Some examples are:
help_modal.ui_events_alliance: Alliance - Alliance requests can be accepted or rejected. Allies can share resources and troops, but can't attack each other. Clicking Focus moves the view to the player who sent the request.
help_modal.ui_events_attack: Attacks - Incoming attacks and your outgoing attacks are shown. Click the message to center the view on the attack, nuke or Boat (transport ship). You can retreat troops by clicking the red X button. This will cost the lives of 25% of your attacking troops. If you retrieve a Boat attack, the boat returns to its starting point and will attack there if the land has been captured since. Nukes can't be retreated once launched.
help_modal.ui_events_quickchat: Quick Chat - You can see sent and received chat messages here. Send a message to a player by clicking the Quick Chat icon in their Info menu.
help_modal.ui_options_desc: The following elements can be found inside:
help_modal.ui_playeroverlay_desc: When you hover over a country, the Player info overlay appears. It shows the player type (Human, Nation, or Tribe), a Nation's attitude toward you (Hostile to Friendly), defending troops, gold, and the number of Warships and buildings they have.
help_modal.option_pause: Pause/Unpause the game - Unavailable in public games.
help_modal.option_speed: Speed - Adjust the game speed. Unavailable in public games.
help_modal.option_timer: Timer - Time passed since the start of the game.
help_modal.option_settings: Settings - Open the settings menu. Inside you can toggle things like Alternate view, Emojis, Dark Mode, Hidden names, action on left click and more.
help_modal.radial_desc: Right clicking (or touch on mobile) opens the Radial menu. Right click outside it to close it. From the menu you can:
help_modal.radial_boat: Send a Boat (transport ship) to attack at the selected location. Only available if you have access to water.
help_modal.radial_donate_troops: Donate troops equivalent to your attack ratio slider percentage to the ally you opened the radial menu on.
help_modal.radial_donate_gold: Opens the gold donation slider menu so you can quickly send allies gold.
help_modal.info_enemy_desc: Contains information such as the selected player's name, gold, troops, stopped trading with you, nukes sent to you, and if the player is a traitor. Stopped trading means you won't receive gold from them and they won't sent you gold via trade ships. Manually (if the player clicked "Stop trading", which lasts until you both click "Start trading") or automatically (if you betrayed your alliance, which lasts until you become allies again or after 5 minutes). Traitor displays Yes for 30 seconds when the player betrayed and attacked a player who was in an alliance with them. The icons below represent the following interactions:
help_modal.info_chat: Send a quick chat message to the player. Select a Category, a Phrase, and if the phrase contains [P1] select a Player name to replace it with. Hit Send.
help_modal.info_target: Place a target mark on the player, marking it for all allies, used to coordinate attacks.
help_modal.info_alliance: Send an alliance request to the player. Allies can share resources and troops, but can't attack each other.
help_modal.info_emoji: Send an emoji to the player.
help_modal.info_trade: Use "Stop trading" to stop giving the player gold and receiving their gold via trade ships. If you both click "Start trading" it will start again.
help_modal.info_ally_desc: When you ally with a player, the following new icons become available:
help_modal.ally_betray: Betray your ally, ending the alliance, halting trade, and weakening your defense. Trading between you is paused for 5 minutes (or until you become allies again) and others may stop trading too. And unless the other player was a traitor themselves, you'll be marked a traitor for 30 seconds. During this time an icon will be above your name and you will have a 50% defense debuff. Tribes are less likely to ally with you and players will think twice before doing so.
help_modal.ally_donate: Donate some of your troops to your ally. Used when they're low on troops and are being attacked, or when they need that extra power to crush an enemy.
help_modal.ally_donate_gold: Donate some of your gold to your ally. Used when they're low on gold and need it for buildings, or when your team member is saving for that MIRV.
help_modal.build_menu_desc: Build these or see how many of each you already build:
help_modal.build_city_desc: Increases your max population. Useful when you can't expand your territory or you're about to hit your population limit.
help_modal.build_factory_desc: Automatically builds railroads to nearby cities, ports and other factories, and can also link up with friendly neighbors. Trains spawn regularly and give you a fixed amount of gold for each building they visit along the route, with extra gold for visiting your neighbors' buildings.
help_modal.build_defense_desc: Increases defenses around nearby borders, which show a checkered pattern. Attacks from enemies are slower and have more casualties.
help_modal.build_port_desc: Can only be built near water. Allows building Warships. Automatically sends trade ships between ports of your country and other countries (except when trade is stopped), giving gold to both sides. Trade with a player stops automatically when you attack or are attacked by a player. It resumes after 5 minutes or if you become allies. You can manually toggle trading with "Stop trading" or "Start trading".
help_modal.build_warship_desc: Patrols in an area, capturing enemy trade ships and destroying their Boats (transport ships) and Warships. Spawns from the nearest Port and patrols the area you first clicked to build it. You can control Warships by attack-clicking on them (see action Attack under Hotkeys) and then attack-clicking the new area you want them to move to.
help_modal.build_sam_desc: Can intercept enemy missiles in its 100 pixel range. The SAM has a 7.5 second cooldown.
help_modal.build_atom_desc: Small explosive bomb that destroys territory, buildings, ships and boats. Spawns from the nearest Missile Silo and lands in the area you first clicked to build it.
help_modal.build_hydrogen_desc: Large explosive bomb. Spawns from the nearest Missile Silo and lands in the area you first clicked to build it.
help_modal.build_mirv_desc: The most powerful bomb in the game. Splits up into smaller bombs that will cover a huge range of territory. Only damages the player that you first clicked on to build it. Spawns from the nearest Missile Silo and lands in the area you first clicked to build it.
help_modal.troubleshooting_desc: If you experience performance issues, crashes, or other problems while playing terron, please visit our Troubleshooting page for help diagnosing and fixing common issues:
help_modal.icon_desc: Examples of some of the ingame icons you will encounter and what they mean:
help_modal.icon_crown: Crown - Number 1. This is the top player in the leaderboard.
help_modal.icon_traitor: Broken shield - Traitor. This player attacked an ally.
help_modal.icon_ally: Handshake - Ally. This player is your ally.
help_modal.icon_embargo: Dollar stop sign - Embargo. This player has stopped trading with you automatically or manually.
help_modal.icon_request: Envelope - Alliance request. This player has sent you an alliance request.

desc.mirv: A huge number of cluster explosions aimed only at the selected player
desc.warship: Captures trade ships, destroys ships and boats
desc.port: Sends trade ships to generate gold
desc.airport: Sends aircraft to generate gold and deploy troops
desc.suicide_drone: Kamikaze drone from your nearest airport: flies to the target tile and explodes (½ the price of an atom bomb, ⅓ the blast). SAMs shoot it down.
desc.ministry_of_truth: Spire that drains population from hostile lands around it. You can build a second one — stronger (×1.5 effect) but twice the cost.
desc.fortifications: Defense posts cost −20%, gain +20% effectiveness and radius, and quietly auto-seize hostile land around them (no attack alert). The HQ is itself a bunker (×2 radius). Upgrading (up to lvl 3): +25% radius for ALL bunkers per level.
desc.central_bank: Your trade ships cannot be intercepted; your planes pay no flyover fees
desc.air_command: Airborne assaults are free, land at full strength and hold twice as long
desc.tank_factory: Your attacks are 15% stronger and ignore enemy defense post bonuses
desc.split: Propaganda strike: aim at an enemy country and a flag-shaped chunk secedes to a new bot. The 'Т' at the center stays yours but you have 60s to connect it to your land or it falls to the bot too. The more troops you commit, the bigger the flag.
desc.religion: Your whole territory slowly creeps outward, quietly absorbing foreign land (even allied). Leaves wasteland, fallout and anyone you are fighting alone. Crosses narrow water but not the open sea. Build as many temples as you like: each converts one more tile — and cuts another 10% off your current income.
desc.mining: {mining_pct}% of any troops landing on you BY SEA die on the mines before the fight (naval invasions only — not airborne or land attacks).
desc.revanchism: A passive with no building: remembers your peak territory. As you lose land from that peak, your whole territory defends harder — up to +200% at near-total loss. Plus revenge: whoever attacked you first takes 50% more from your attacks.
desc.our_sky: The HQ is itself a giant SAM (intercept radius ×5), and all your SAMs reload twice as fast.
desc.satellite_strike: Assembles on your land for a minute (everyone is warned — and can raze it). The launch blinds all enemies with fog of war for 60 seconds; your team is spared.
desc.closed_country: Everyone else sees '???' instead of your troops, gold and attack sizes — on the map, in the leaderboard and in the player panel. Your team keeps its sight.
desc.piracy: All your warships are pirate boats: twice as fast, a flat 100K each (one every 5s), half the firepower, 200 HP. Landings only from your ports — but SILENT: no alarm, no trail, invisible until close to shore.
desc.blockade: (5M + boats) pick a spot in the ocean within range of your port — your pirate boats sail there (the attack slider sets how many), and a flag-shaped zone rises that other nations' ships route around. More boats — bigger flag.
desc.pride: The further you lag behind the leader in territory, the faster your population and gold grow — up to ×2 for the very last. The leader gets nothing. The HQ itself is the cheapest in the game (1M).
desc.respite: (1M + troops) peace around you: nobody attacks you, you attack nobody (missiles and SAMs still work); attacks under way are recalled. The slider sets the price and duration: 20% ≈ 1 min, 50% ≈ 2, 100% ≈ 3. Pride bonuses double for the duration. No cooldown.
desc.truce: (10M) world peace for 60 seconds: no attacks, no ship fire, no interceptions (missiles still fly); attacks under way are recalled. Your stadium bonus rises to +100% for the duration. 3-minute cooldown.
desc.fanaticism: Population grows three times faster, but gold income is halved and attacks are half as effective (your attackers lose twice the troops).
desc.terror: (5M + troops) aim at an enemy country — for 100 seconds its finished buildings blow up one by one. The slider sets the price and blast count: 10% ≈ 3, 50% = 10, 100% = 15. Recast on the same target stacks.
desc.victory_banner: Every capital you hold — yours and captured — pays ×10; captured capitals stay capitals, their former owners cannot found a new one, and your attacks against each such victim are 50% more effective. Lose a capital, lose its bonus; lose the HQ, lose everything.
desc.peace_palace: Whoever betrays you stays a traitor for 60 seconds instead of 30, and nations always accept your alliance requests (up to 2 nation alliances at once).
desc.pact: (15M) a forced 5-minute alliance with a living player's country. Symmetric: neither side can attack; attacks under way roll on. One target at a time; the victim can only break it as a traitor.
desc.greens: Nuclear weapons are off-limits to you — even from captured silos. In exchange: silos house people like cities, growth +30%, income −10%, radiation retreats from your borders, and burnt land costs 5x fewer troops to retake. Anyone whose nuke detonates gets a civilian airliner from your HQ carrying an income fine of up to −30% — it cannot be shot down; the only answer is to raze the HQ while it flies.
desc.catastrophe: (5M) aim at any country — its income drops 10% for 2 minutes. Stacks with the nuke penalty into one shared −30% cap: a cast for peaceful rich neighbours. Troop growth is untouched — the victim keeps a growing army with no money and is pushed to attack.
desc.nuclear_plant: Nukes cost you 30% less and burnt land takes 3x fewer troops to retake — fresh craters become your invasion corridor. Lose the plant in any way and a hydrogen-scale blast levels the site a minute later.
desc.recultivation: (500K) clears radioactive ash instantly across a wide radius — on your land or anyone else's, no consent asked. Ash on land that was yours mints gold; ash on another player's land is billed straight out of their treasury.
desc.fuel: Everything of yours that moves under its own power goes twice as fast — warships, landing craft, trade ships, aircraft and trains (drones and missiles are not).
desc.industrial_revolution: (5M) any country, including YOUR OWN: for 2 minutes everything it moves goes three times as fast, but its population growth is halved. A gift to a trader, a noose to a warmonger, a burst window for yourself. Nobody can refuse it. Does not stack.
desc.rail_gun: A heavy railway gun — a building that DRIVES along your railway, which grows between your buildings: its true reach is your own construction. Can be captured with the ground or destroyed by drones and nukes. Rides on allied land, but break the alliance and it detonates a minute later.
desc.rail_gun_shell: (100K) mark a target anywhere on land: in range — the gun fires once its minute-long reload is done; out of range — it drives along the rails until it can reach. The shell lands instantly and cannot be intercepted. The counterplay is the tracks: destroy the station behind the gun and it is stranded.
desc.spaceport: Once a minute a launch goes up: a flat payment plus 1% of the income every other country earned during that minute — straight out of their pockets. Every launch is announced to everyone with the figure attached. Built on your land or out at sea (the sea pad costs more and pays more).
desc.peaceful_sky: SAMs cost half as much, but they shoot down EVERYTHING hostile in range — including your allies' missiles. Nobody flies above you any more, not even friends.
desc.submarine_base: All your warships are submarines: until a submarine fires, the enemy cannot see it or target it. Once it fires, it stays revealed for the rest of the match.
desc.oil_rig: An offshore platform: built far out in the OPEN ocean. It sends no ships of its own, but ships flock to it and pay many times a port rate, and it repairs your warships five times faster. It cannot be taken with land, only a nuke kills it, and it sinks with you if you lose.
desc.rivers_back: A hydro complex: all its power is in the water missile. While it stands, you can launch one from any missile silo.
desc.water_nuke: Land inside the crater turns to water FOREVER — cut isthmuses, sink buildings along with the ground. Launched from a missile silo; SAMs intercept it like any missile.
desc.media: An aura drains troops from enemies around it (half goes to you), and betraying alliances is never punished — no traitor mark.
desc.nuclear_factory: The only source of MIRVs: every launch is 5M cheaper — you already paid for the factory. Raze the factory and MIRVs are locked again.
desc.train_depot: Your trains run twice as fast.
desc.doom_train: Send a ticking train along your own railway. It detonates where it stops — tear up the rails ahead of it and it blows up short of the target.
desc.pirate_ship: Captures trade ships, destroys ships and boats
desc.submarine: Captures trade ships, destroys ships and boats
desc.walking_city: Your buildings can walk. The Relocation cast moves buildings from a zone to a new spot.
desc.city_transfer: Pick a zone (size = troop slider, up to 30% spent), then a destination. Buildings walk there at 1 tile/sec and keep working on the way. Ports walk along the coast.

feed-parsing-2026-06.title: Feed is more readable
feed-parsing-2026-06.desc: Service messages in chat (captures, gold, landings, incoming nukes) now have icons and compact text — easy to read.

public-lobbies-2026-06.title: Public lobbies on the home page
public-lobbies-2026-06.desc: Create a public lobby — it shows up on the home page for anyone to join. Private ones are still by link.

lobby-modes-2026-06.title: New game creation
lobby-modes-2026-06.desc: Offline vs bots, private or public — pick it right in the lobby settings, on the fly.

glass-ui-2026-06.title: Frosted-glass UI
glass-ui-2026-06.desc: In-game panels are now translucent — the map is more visible and the UI feels lighter.

english-2026-06.title: English localization
english-2026-06.desc: Switch the language to English — the interface is now fully localized.

account-delete-2026-06.title: Account deletion & legal pages
account-delete-2026-06.desc: Added an account-deletion page, and translated the Terms and Privacy Policy into two languages.

ui-redesign-2026-05.title: UI completely redesigned
ui-redesign-2026-05.desc: The site and game got a fresh 'command-map' look.

skins-2026-05.title: Territory skins
skins-2026-05.desc: Three skin types — tiled, stretched, static — plus custom ones. Color your own territory.

achievements-2026-05.title: Achievements & titles
achievements-2026-05.desc: Earn achievements for combat and wear titles on your dossier.

daily-2026-05.title: Daily tasks
daily-2026-05.desc: New tasks with rewards every day.

referrals-2026-05.title: Referral system
referrals-2026-05.desc: Invite friends by link and earn rewards for their play.

mobile-2026-06.title: Mobile app
mobile-2026-06.desc: Android is in development now, iOS comes next week.

aviation-2026-07.title: New forces: aviation
aviation-2026-07.desc: Airports, trade planes, airborne assaults and kamikaze drones are live.

offline-resume-2026-07-21.title: Resume offline games
offline-resume-2026-07-21.desc: You can now continue an unfinished singleplayer or offline match — reload the page and you are back in the same game. The offline create-game screen now has a Resume unfinished list.

stability-2026-07-21.title: Start, lobby & low-end PCs
stability-2026-07-21.desc: Fixed match-start freezes and crashes, catch-up after reconnect, and returning to the lobby on refresh. Graphics are steadier on weak devices. Game won't start? Open terron.io/debug to see why.

wiki-ultimates-2026-07.title: Wiki: every ultimate
wiki-ultimates-2026-07.desc: A new wiki page for ultimates: what they do, exact stats and what they unlock. The "ultimates" link is in the site footer.

new-ultimates-2026-07.title: New ultimates
new-ultimates-2026-07.desc: Religion, Split, Revanchism, Mining and Media — five new abilities. One per match; your pick locks in on first use.

nuclear-factory-2026-07.title: Nuclear Factory & MIRV
nuclear-factory-2026-07.desc: MIRV is now unlocked by the Nuclear Factory building — build it once and launch as many as you like. Media unlocks Split the same way.

our-sky-2026-07.title: "Our Sky" ultimate
our-sky-2026-07.desc: An anti-satellite complex: after a 60-second telegraph it blankets everyone but you in fog of war for a minute.

fog-of-war-2026-07.title: Fog of war
fog-of-war-2026-07.desc: A new lobby mode: you only see your own and allied territory plus a ring around it and your units. Toggle it in the game settings.

fortifications-levels-2026-07.title: Fortifications level up
fortifications-levels-2026-07.desc: The fortifications HQ upgrades to 3 levels — bunkers capture land in an ever wider radius.

lobby-chat-2026-07.title: Lobby chat & countdown
lobby-chat-2026-07.desc: Chat with everyone while you wait for the match. Plus a visible countdown to the start that the host can cancel.

performance-2026-07.title: Faster start, fewer lags
performance-2026-07.desc: A big optimization pass: matches start faster, the GPU works less, the map renders smoother and uses less traffic.

stability-2026-07.title: Stability & reconnect
stability-2026-07.desc: Fixed rare crashes (WebGL, building, stuck loading). Matches survive a server restart — after a drop the client catches up on its own.
